quests.title: Summer Gift

dialogue.t: Hmm? Looks like there's a letter next to it, too...
To a friend who may have the fortune to come here,
Hello there, person from afar. If you're reading this letter, then you must have found the harpastum I left here.
The Golden Apple Archipelago is full of many games that involve harpasta, and I and my friends spent a most wonderful summer here.
As such, I've left a harpastum that I made myself here, in the hopes that you, who have found that harpastum, can experience the same joys as I.
Please enjoy the sunshine, the sea breeze, and the summer games to fullest.
Well, that's Barbara for you! Guess we've got ourselves a harpastum now, so come on, let's go play!
(test)这应该就是召唤船只的设施吧...看着有点神秘，真的没问题吗？

quests.description: A mysterious, joyous gift lies somewhere, waiting to be discovered…
